## What changed and why

## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test (a security fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Generated files are up to date (`npm run build`)

## What was **not** tested

State anything that was only simulated or only prepared (real Google Sheets, real model, real n8n).

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, real sheet ids, real URLs or real personal data in code, tests, docs or images
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated when behaviour, data columns or setup steps changed
- [ ] No claim stronger than the evidence (see docs/TEST_REPORT.md for the vocabulary)
